name: J.R.S. Fine Furniture
old_description: Welcome to JRS Fine Furniture. A place to view and shop current pieces large and small along with many pictures of mostly past works and documented processes of the wide world of making things.
about:
J.R.S. Fine Furniture operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where a third-generation craftsman continues a family tradition of making rooted in the Rio Grande Valley. The artisan credits grandparents, mother, and father for early lessons in working with wood and other materials, establishing a practice guided by cultural heritage and the surrounding landscape.

The workshop produces one-of-a-kind furniture pieces including dishes, tables, and integrated planters, each handcrafted from materials such as paduk, cherry, hard rock maple, and ash woods, as well as cement, laminate, and brass accents. A growing catalog of available items is complemented by limited custom commissions, and any piece can be reproduced to order.

The business serves individual clients and design professionals seeking custom furniture and limited-run reproductions, with direct sales through an expanding online catalog and commissioned work arranged on a case-by-case basis.

The maker emphasizes generational skill and the use of only the finest materials, drawing inspiration from New Mexican culture and the natural world to create pieces described as unique works of art built for generations.
